checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly five 4:5 portrait images, no cover/closing

must.why: All five texts correct and in order.
Desk with lamp, muted phone, checklist, stopwatch, coffee cup all match; slide 3 icon is tiny and slide 2 bell is muddy.

must.item: Consistent clean blue-and-white design, readable, unclipped
must.why: Blue/white throughout and text readable; layout, badge style and icon size vary between slides.

faults.what: Inconsistent layout across slides: number badge size and style, text size and position, and illustration size all vary (slide 5 wraps to two lines).
Slide 3 illustration is very small and the slide looks empty.
Slide 2 muted bell icon is muddy and hard to read.
Low resolution (512x640) and content sits oddly with large blank areas.

summary: Five clean blue-and-white 4:5 slides with correct text, numbering and relevant icons, but layout and icon sizes are inconsistent between slides and slide 3's icon is tiny.
